articles.titleCn: 具备可靠依据、忠实、一致且可操作的推理的问责型人工智能：VERDICT在临床试验匹配中的案例研究
articles.abstractCn: 问责制意味着一个决策可以被审查、辩护和质疑。大型语言模型（LLM）使这一点变得困难：流畅的输出可能缺乏依据、不完整或不忠实于决策过程。实现问责制需要经过验证的推理依据（决策是如何做出的）、假设（被假设而非已知的内容）、政策一致性（相同事实得到相同处理）以及关键条件（什么会改变结果）。我们引入自我忠实性作为问责制的自动测试方法：改变关键条件应该会改变决策。我们通过临床试验匹配来检验问责制人工智能，这是一项高风险任务，是循证医学的核心。尽管基于LLM的匹配器在将患者匹配到试验方面表现合理准确，但它们在应用决策政策时缺乏一致性，并且产生的推理与其自身决策不忠实。我们引入VERDICT，这是一个基于LLM的智能体，它将决策任务、其约束条件及其政策转换为理论可满足性（SMT），然后使用SMT和MaxSMT求解器推导出决策——因此政策得到一致应用，决策通过设计实现问责制。在SIGIR 2016衍生数据集和TREC 2021上，VERDICT在仅基于LLM和神经符号基线中实现了最强的决策准确率，以完美的一致性应用政策，并产生基于明确假设和关键条件的临床医生偏好的推理，同时提高了反事实自我忠实性。

articles.title: ALRA: Adaptive Local Relational Alignment for Logit-Based Pre-training Distillation of Autoregressive Language Models
articles.abstract: Logit-based knowledge distillation for autoregressive language models usually aligns teacher and student next-token distributions over the entire vocabulary. However, this global objective overlooks relative preferences among likely token alternatives. Existing local approaches often select candidate tokens from either the teacher or the student alone. Teacher-only selection can miss tokens that the student considers likely, while student-only selection can rely on an inaccurate ranking early in training. We propose Adaptive Local Relational Alignment (ALRA), a position-specific framework combining student proposals with teacher guidance. At each valid prediction position, the student proposes likely tokens, while the teacher's most probable token is included as an anchor. ALRA adjusts the number of selected tokens according to how broadly the teacher distributes probability within this candidate set relative to the current batch. Adaptive Local Divergence retains the mass-matching term and separately matches the relative token distributions within the selected and remaining vocabulary regions. Unlike the exact full-vocabulary decomposition, it replaces the teacher-mass coefficients of the two conditional terms with unit coefficients, preventing either term from being downweighted solely because its region has low teacher probability. Student-Weighted Pairwise Relational Alignment emphasizes high-probability token pairs with small student probability gaps and gives less weight to unlikely or clearly separated pairs. Experiments on The Pile with randomly initialized 200M- and 500M-parameter students across nine zero-shot benchmarks yield average accuracies of 36.62% and 37.40%. ALRA exceeds the strongest competing distillation baseline by 0.94 and 0.83 percentage points and improves over pre-training without distillation by 2.31 and 2.91 points, respectively.
articles.titleCn: ALRA：自适应局部关系对齐，用于基于 logits 的自回归语言模型预训练蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 基于Logit的知识蒸馏通常在整个词汇表上对自回归语言模型的教师和学生的下一个词分布进行对齐。然而，这种全局目标忽略了可能词替代之间的相对偏好。现有的局部方法通常仅从教师或学生中单独选择候选词。仅选择教师词可能会遗漏学生认为可能的词，而仅选择学生词则可能在训练初期依赖不准确排序。我们提出了自适应局部关系对齐（ALRA），这是一个特定位置框架，结合了学生建议和教师指导。在每个有效预测位置，学生提出可能的词，而教师最可能的词被作为锚点包含在内。ALRA根据教师在这些候选集中分配概率的广度相对于当前批次来调整所选词的数量。自适应局部发散保留了质量匹配项，并分别匹配所选和剩余词汇区域内的相对词分布。与精确的全词汇分解不同，它用单位系数替换了两个条件项的教师质量系数，防止任何一项仅因其区域教师概率低而被降权。学生加权成对关系对齐强调高概率词对且学生概率差距小的词对，而较少关注不太可能或明显分离的词对。在The Pile上对随机初始化的2000万和5000万参数学生进行实验，涵盖九个零样本基准，平均准确率分别为36.62%和37.40%。ALRA比最强的竞争蒸馏基线分别提高了0.94和0.83个百分点，并且相对于无蒸馏的预训练分别提高了2.31和2.91个百分点。

articles.title: From Zero to Hero: An Open LLM Ecosystem for Armenian
articles.abstract: Pretraining data for Armenian, a morphologically rich and low-resource language, is scarce, and no open Armenian LLM has been released with the data and recipe needed to reproduce it. To address this gap, we curate and release two datasets. ArmWeb is an extensively validated corpus of 4.37M Armenian news documents. ArmSTEM is a parallel English-Armenian collection of 373K math and science problems with step-by-step solutions, translated into Armenian and verified through both answer-preserving LLM judgment and human evaluation. Continued pretraining of Gemma-4-E4B on these datasets yields arm-gemma-e4b, which outperforms every existing open Armenian model as well as its unadapted base, and is the first open Armenian LLM with complete training data and recipe. Our ablations show that news-only continued pretraining improves fluency while eroding knowledge, a pattern we also observe in existing Armenian models, and that a small share of verified translated STEM data reverses the loss. We further find that the largest public Armenian corpora overlap web-derived evaluation panels heavily, including a train/test self-overlap inside FineWeb-2. We openly release all data, models, and code.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables. Data and model: https://huggingface.co/collections/COPA-AI/armenian-llm-ecosystem. Code: https://github.com/COPATeam/armenian_llm_ecosystem
articles.titleCn: 从零到英雄：一个面向亚美尼亚的开源大型语言模型生态系统
articles.abstractCn: 亚美尼亚语是一种形态丰富且资源匮乏的语言，其预训练数据稀少，目前还没有公开的亚美尼亚大型语言模型（LLM）发布所需的完整数据和训练方法。为填补这一空白，我们整理并发布了两个数据集。ArmWeb是一个经过广泛验证的包含437万份亚美尼亚语新闻文档的语料库。ArmSTEM是一个包含37.3万个英语-亚美尼亚语对照的数学和科学问题及其逐步解决方案的平行语料库，这些问题均被翻译成亚美尼亚语，并通过答案保留型LLM判断和人工评估进行验证。在上述数据集上对Gemma-4-E4B进行持续预训练，生成了arm-gemma-e4b模型，该模型不仅优于所有现有的公开亚美尼亚语模型及其未适配的基座模型，而且是首个拥有完整训练数据和训练方法的公开亚美尼亚语LLM。我们的消融实验表明，仅使用新闻数据进行持续预训练可以提高流畅性但会损害知识性，这一模式在现有的亚美尼亚语模型中也有观察到，而一小部分经过验证的翻译STEM数据可以逆转这一损失。此外，我们发现最大的公开亚美尼亚语语料库与网络衍生评估集高度重叠，包括FineWeb-2内部训练集与测试集的自我重叠。我们公开发布了所有数据、模型和代码。

articles.title: FPCO-Dialog: A Multi-Turn False-Premise Benchmark for Correction and Cooperation in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-turn settings where users may describe visual content with incorrect assumptions. Yet existing evaluations rarely isolate how models respond when the same visually grounded false premise persists across dialogue turns. We introduce FPCO-Dialog, a benchmark for evaluating correction and cooperation behavior in VLMs under repeated false premises. FPCO-Dialog contains 1,080 images and 10,800 question turns, stratified by visual complexity, object category, and false-premise class, and uses a 10-turn protocol in which a correct dialogue prefix is followed by repeated false-premise referring expressions. We evaluate 20 commercial and open-source VLMs with a model-agnostic protocol and CorrTP@K, a correction-rate metric over false-premise turns, scored by two independent detectors. FPCO-Dialog reveals substantial and persistent cross-model differences in aggregate correction tendency, model-specific turn-wise dynamics, and systematic variation across false-premise types under the benchmark's substitution distribution. The dataset, evaluation protocol, model outputs, detector labels, and code are available.
articles.comment: Accepted at EMNLP2026 Main Conference. For code and data, see https://github.com/lab-klc/FPCO-Dialog
articles.titleCn: FPCO-Dialog：一个用于视觉语言模型中纠错与合作的回合式虚假前提基准
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）越来越多地应用于多轮对话场景，其中用户可能会基于错误的前提描述视觉内容。然而，现有的评估很少孤立地分析模型在多轮对话中持续存在同一视觉相关错误前提时的响应方式。我们引入了FPCO-Dialog，这是一个用于评估VLMs在重复错误前提下修正与合作行为的基准。FPCO-Dialog包含1,080张图像和10,800个问题轮次，根据视觉复杂度、物体类别和错误前提类别进行分层，并采用一个10轮协议，其中包含一个正确的对话前缀，随后是重复的错误前提指称表达。我们使用模型无关的协议和CorrTP@K（错误前提轮次的修正率指标），由两个独立检测器评分，评估了20个商业和开源VLMs。FPCO-Dialog揭示了在总体修正倾向、特定模型的轮次动态以及基准替换分布下错误前提类型的系统性变化方面存在显著且持续跨模型的差异。该数据集、评估协议、模型输出、检测器标签和代码均已公开。

articles.title: Less Is Moral: A CHARMing Framework for Moral Foundations Detection in Endorsement Behaviour
articles.abstract: Moral language plays a central role in shaping online endorsement and the diffusion of information, yet existing moral foundation detection systems often suffer from poor cross-domain generalization, weak rationale grounding, and reliance on costly prompting-based large language models (LLMs). We introduce CHARM, a MA\textbf{C}- and \textbf{H}ate-speech-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}ationale-aligned \textbf{M}oral foundation detection framework built on a lightweight fine-tuned LLM, which integrates complementary moral grounding, rationale alignment, and polarity-aware hate speech signals to support more robust and faithful moral prediction. Unlike prior dictionary-, fine-tune-, or prompt-based detectors, which decouple computation from psychological theory, CHARM is built so that each component -- MAC cross-attention, rationale alignment, and hate-speech modulation -- operationalizes a distinct psychological construct. Using a 30\% subsample of the MFTC, MFRC, and News training pools together with the richer supervision in MFTCXplain, CHARM improves AUC by up to 15.3\% in-domain, surpasses the supervised baselines on every out-of-domain dataset in both AUC and F1, and offers a scalable, low-cost alternative to prompting-based LLM detectors. We further apply CHARM to large-scale COVID-19 discourse on Twitter and show that moral value alignment is strongly associated with online endorsement behavior. By making moral framing measurable at scale, CHARM offers a practical tool for studying the spread of morally charged misinformation.
articles.titleCn: 少即是德：一种用于检测推荐行为中道德基础的CHARM框架
articles.abstractCn: 道德语言在塑造网络背书和信息传播中扮演着核心角色，然而现有的道德基础检测系统往往存在跨领域泛化能力差、推理依据薄弱以及对成本高昂的提示式大型语言模型（LLM）的依赖问题。我们介绍了CHARM，这是一个基于轻量级微调LLM构建的MA\textbf{C}-和\textbf{H}ate-speech-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}ationale-aligned \textbf{M}oral foundation detection框架，该框架整合了互补的道德基础、推理对齐和情感感知的仇恨言论信号，以支持更稳健和忠实的道德预测。与以往脱离计算与心理理论的词典式、微调式或提示式检测器不同，CHARM的设计使得每个组件——MAC跨注意力、推理对齐和仇恨言论调制——都对应一个独特的心理结构。使用MFTC、MFRC和News训练集的30%子样本以及MFTCXplain中更丰富的监督信息，CHARM在领域内AUC提升了高达15.3%，在所有领域外数据集上均超越了监督基线，并提供了可扩展、低成本的提示式LLM检测器替代方案。我们进一步将CHARM应用于Twitter上大规模的COVID-19讨论，并表明道德价值观对齐与网络背书行为密切相关。通过使道德框架规模化可衡量，CHARM为研究带有道德色彩的错误信息传播提供了实用工具。

articles.title: How Perturbations Propagate: A Multi-Level Analysis of Robustness in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Language models encounter typos, corrupted text, altered words, and disrupted token order, yet robustness is usually evaluated only through output behavior. We study how six naturalistic and synthetic input perturbations propagate through decoder-only language models at three levels: output behavior, hidden-state geometry, and attention-head function. We evaluate behavioral effects across four GPT-2 and two Qwen2.5 checkpoints by analyzing layerwise geometry using centered kernel alignment and intrinsic dimension, and examine attention-head responses in GPT-2. Perturbation types produce distinguishable metric profiles that are not fully captured by output measures and are only partly consistent across the tested checkpoints. Copying scores are especially associated with activation-patching recovery under token substitution and shuffling. Gradient-guided HotFlip perturbations also cause stronger behavioral and representational disruption than rate-matched random token substitutions in GPT-2; their behavioral effects are consistent across all six tested checkpoints. Our results show that robustness claims based on a single behavioral or representational metric can be misleading, and motivate multi-level evaluation of how perturbations alter language-model computation.
articles.titleCn: 扰动如何传播：对大型语言模型鲁棒性的多级分析
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型会遭遇拼写错误、损坏的文本、词语篡改和token顺序混乱等问题，但鲁棒性通常仅通过输出行为来评估。我们研究了六种自然和合成输入扰动如何在仅解码器语言模型的三个层面——输出行为、隐藏状态几何和注意力头函数——中传播。我们通过使用中心核对齐和固有维度分析层级几何，评估了四个GPT-2和两个Qwen2.5检查点的行为效应，并检查了GPT-2中的注意力头响应。扰动类型产生了可区分的度量特征，这些特征不能完全由输出度量捕捉，且在测试的检查点之间只有部分一致性。复制分数尤其与token替换和打乱下的激活块恢复相关。在GPT-2中，梯度引导的HotFlip扰动比速率匹配的随机token替换造成更强的行为和表示破坏；它们的行为效应在所有六个测试检查点中是一致的。我们的结果表明，基于单一行为或表示度量的鲁棒性声明可能具有误导性，并推动对扰动如何改变语言模型计算的多层次评估。

articles.title: Decoupling Turn-Taking from Semantics: A Decoupled Data Approach for Finite-State-Machine-Based Full-Duplex Dialogue
articles.abstract: The Neural Finite State Machine (NFSM) framework offers a pragmatic path to full-duplex dialogue by serializing turn-taking control and response generation onto a single causal tape under the standard next-token prediction objective, thereby preserving semantic prowess at a low fine-tuning cost. However, its reliance on synthetic text data fundamentally limits turn-taking naturalness, as Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot faithfully simulate the fine-grained acoustic temporal dynamics of real human dialogues. In this work, we propose a decoupled data approach that learns turn-taking from real Human-Human (HH) spoken dialogues while shaping semantic behavior through configurable Human-Agent (HA) text dialogues. To operationalize this approach, we introduce a rule-based event-guided data transformation method that serializes HH spoken dialogues into FSM tapes by classifying turn-taking events and applying deterministic mapping rules, enabling scalable supervision without LLM-generated annotations. We further propose a Source-Aware Calibrated (SAC) Loss that jointly calibrates the long-tailed distribution of state transition tokens and channels each data source toward the capability it best supervises. Experiments show that our approach substantially improves turn-taking proficiency while recovering the foundation LLM's semantic capability. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/Liyht/def-fsm.
articles.titleCn: 将轮流发言与语义解耦：基于有限状态机全双工对话的解耦数据方法
articles.abstractCn: 神经有限状态机（NFSM）框架通过将轮流控制与响应生成序列化到标准下一词预测目标下的单个因果带上，为全双工对话提供了一条务实的路径，从而以较低的超参数调整成本保留了语义能力。然而，其对合成文本数据的依赖从根本上限制了轮流的自然性，因为大型语言模型（LLM）无法忠实地模拟真实人类对话中微细粒度的声学时间动态。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种解耦数据方法，通过从真实人类-人类（HH）口语对话中学习轮流，并通过可配置的人类-智能体（HA）文本对话塑造语义行为。为了实现这种方法，我们引入了一种基于规则的、事件引导的数据转换方法，通过分类轮流事件并应用确定性映射规则，将HH口语对话序列化为FSM带，从而实现无需LLM生成的注释的可扩展监督。我们进一步提出了一种源感知校准（SAC）损失，该损失联合校准状态转换标记的长尾分布，并将每个数据源引导至其最能监督的能力。实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了轮流能力，同时恢复了基础LLM的语义能力。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/Liyht/def-fsm获取。

articles.title: PACE: Towards Surfacing Hidden Conflicts in User Requests
articles.abstract: Personalized assistants should not only comply with user requests but also assess whether those requests are appropriate given the user's current circumstances. However, prior work has primarily focused on accurately executing requests, overlooking the need for assistants to account for context and engage in conflict-based refusal. Furthermore, while existing work on conflict or safety detection relies on explicitly provided factors, real-world scenarios often involve implicit factors that must be retrieved from a knowledge base (KB). To this end, we introduce Personalized Assistants for Conflict Evaluation (PACE), a dataset for evaluating whether models can identify latent constraints, expressed as egocentric knowledge or events, that render seemingly reasonable user requests inappropriate. PACE pairs user requests grounded in well-defined personas with egocentric KB facts, requiring models to integrate contextual evidence to determine whether a request is conflicting. This implicit retrieval setting hinders the direct association between user requests and conflict-inducing knowledge, making it difficult for existing models to identify relevant user-specific facts. To address this challenge, we further propose PaceMaker, a multi-agent framework in which specialized agents coordinate across query reformulation, multi-hop graph traversal, and conflict-aware filtering to retrieve contextually decisive evidence. Experiments on PACE evaluate both evidence retrieval quality and conflict decision accuracy, showing that PaceMaker consistently outperforms existing approaches.
articles.titleCn: PACE：揭示用户请求中隐藏的冲突
articles.abstractCn: 个性化助手不仅要遵循用户请求，还要根据用户当前情况评估这些请求是否合适。然而，以往的研究主要集中于准确执行请求，忽视了助手需要考虑上下文并进行基于冲突的拒绝的需求。此外，现有的冲突或安全检测研究依赖于明确提供的因素，而现实场景中往往涉及需要从知识库中检索的隐含因素。为此，我们引入了用于冲突评估的个性化助手（PACE），这是一个用于评估模型是否能够识别潜在约束（以自我中心知识或事件的形式表达）的测试集，这些约束使得看似合理的用户请求变得不合适。PACE将基于明确定义角色的用户请求与自我中心知识库事实配对，要求模型整合上下文证据以确定请求是否存在冲突。这种隐式检索场景阻碍了用户请求与引发冲突的知识之间的直接关联，使得现有模型难以识别相关的用户特定事实。为应对这一挑战，我们进一步提出了PaceMaker，这是一个多智能体框架，其中专门化的智能体在查询重写、多跳图遍历和冲突感知过滤等方面进行协调，以检索具有上下文决定性的证据。在PACE上的实验评估了证据检索质量和冲突决策准确性，结果表明PaceMaker始终优于现有方法。

articles.title: Contextual Tamil Spelling and Grammar Correction Using Progressively Fine-Tuned Sequence-to-Sequence Transformers
articles.abstract: Tamil spell and grammar correction is challenging because Tamil is an agglutinative low-resource language with rich verbal morphology, complex sandhi (phonetic transformation) rules at word boundaries, and a script of 247 distinct letters. Prior work targets word-level surface errors with rule-based methods, statistical n-gram models, Minimum Edit Distance, or hybrid pipelines with a transformer re-ranker; such methods cannot reliably handle contextual errors - subject-verb agreement, tense consistency, or cross-word sandhi - which require sentence-level understanding. We propose an end-to-end sequence-to-sequence formulation and fine-tune mT5-small and mBART-50 on a synthetic corpus of up to 657,720 noisy-clean Tamil sentence pairs spanning ten error categories. Both backbones follow the same four-stage progressive schedule, each stage targeting one weakness: surface noise (v2), contextual grammar (v3), single-site sandhi (v4), and multi-site cross-word sandhi (v5). On a 1,000-sentence balanced diagnostic set verified disjoint from all training data, our best model, mBART-50 v5, reaches 69.3% top-1 exact-match accuracy, with 87.5% on sandhi and 43.5% on subject-verb agreement. The schedule is what produces these gains: subject-verb accuracy rises from 1.0% to 52.5% once contextual pairs are introduced, and sandhi from 0% to 87.5% once multi-site sandhi pairs are. We additionally quantify a precision-recall trade-off this literature has not reported: sandhi recall is paid for monotonically in identity accuracy. Finally, Tamil-LLaMA-7B-Instruct reaches 19.0% zero-shot and 24.7% with three demonstrations against a 20.0% copy baseline, showing that a Tamil-adapted instruction model does not transfer to specialised sentence-level correction without task-specific supervision.
articles.titleCn: 基于逐步微调序列到序列转换器的情境泰米尔拼写和语法校正
articles.abstractCn: 泰米尔语拼写和语法纠错具有挑战性，因为泰米尔语是一种屈折粘着性、资源匮乏且动词形态丰富的低资源语言，具有复杂的词边界音变规则和247个独特的字母表。现有工作主要针对基于规则的、统计n-gram模型、最小编辑距离或混合流水线（含Transformer重排序器）等方法进行词级表面错误处理，但这些方法无法可靠地处理需要句子级理解的上下文错误——主谓一致、时态一致性或跨词音变。我们提出了一种端到端的序列到序列模型，并在一个包含10类错误、最多657,720对含噪声-干净泰米尔语句子的合成语料库上微调mT5-small和mBART-50。两个主干模型都遵循相同的四阶段渐进式训练计划，每个阶段针对一个弱点：表面噪声（v2）、上下文语法（v3）、单位点音变（v4）和多位点跨词音变（v5）。在一个包含1000个句子的平衡诊断集（与所有训练数据独立验证）上，我们的最佳模型mBART-50 v5达到了69.3%的top-1精确匹配准确率，音变准确率为87.5%，主谓一致准确率为43.5%。正是这个训练计划带来了这些提升：一旦引入上下文对，主谓一致准确率从1.0%提升到52.5%，而一旦引入多位点音变对，音变准确率从0%提升到87.5%。此外，我们量化了该领域未报告的精确率-召回率权衡：音变召回率在身份准确率上呈单调下降。最后，泰米尔语LLaMA-7B-Instruct在零样本学习下达到19.0%，在三个示例下达到24.7%（对照20.0%的复制基线），表明没有特定任务监督，泰米尔语适配的指令模型无法迁移到专业句级纠错任务。

articles.title: MedQA-MM: Shortcuts Behind Medical Visual Reasoning
articles.abstract: A benchmark score credits final answers, but not the route by which an item can be answered. In medical multimodal multiple-choice questions (MCQs), this distinction matters because a correct answer can be supported by the intended image finding or by benchmark-preserved cues in the wording of answers, non-visual clinical text, visible image text, artificial annotations, or device/context artifacts. We call the resulting score-level overinterpretation reasoning inflation. Here, a route is an observable input path that can support answer selection, not a claim about the model's hidden cognition. Across six medical multimodal MCQ datasets, we separate candidate cues from behavioral evidence through prompt- and image-side audits, modality ablations, and matched repairs that preserve the medical target and answer key. In a 13-configuration open-model panel, full-input accuracy is 62.63%, while text-only and options-only settings achieve 53.96% and 29.71%, respectively. Removing length-gap, absolute/conspicuous, and spatial/prepositional cues lowers accuracy by 6.58, 3.50, and 4.77 percentage points. We also construct MedQA-MM, a 1,000-item shortcut-mitigated subset, where text-only and options-only accuracy fall to 5.21% and 12.33%. This does not imply that models never use images; it shows that medical image-reasoning claims require route-level evidence.
articles.titleCn: MedQA-MM：医学视觉推理背后的捷径
articles.abstractCn: 基准分数仅认可最终答案，而不认可回答问题的途径。在医学多模态选择题中，这种区分很重要，因为正确答案可能由预期的图像查找支持，也可能由基准保留的答案措辞中的线索、非视觉临床文本、可见图像文本、人工注释或设备/上下文残留物支持。我们将由此产生的得分级过度解释称为推理膨胀。在这里，途径是一个可观察的输入路径，它可以支持答案选择，而不是关于模型隐藏认知的断言。在六个医学多模态选择题数据集上，我们通过提示和图像侧审核、模态消融以及保留医学目标和答案键的匹配修复，将候选线索与行为证据分离。在一个13配置的开源模型面板中，全输入准确率为62.63%，而仅文本和仅选项设置分别达到53.96%和29.71%。移除长度差距、绝对/显著和空间/介词线索将准确率降低6.58、3.50和4.77个百分点。我们还构建了MedQA-MM，这是一个1,000项的缓解捷径子集，其中仅文本和仅选项的准确率降至5.21%和12.33%。这并不意味着模型从不使用图像；它表明医学图像推理断言需要途径级证据。

articles.title: What Else Needs Fixing? Exploring Cost-Effective Test-Time Compute for Revision Propagation in Artifacts Generated Through Conversation
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often help users generate artifacts through iterative cycles of generation and revision in conversation. A challenge here is that, when users specify only a local change during revision, LLMs must instead identify the relevant dependencies and propagate the revision to all affected parts of the artifact. This paper studies this ability of LLMs on conversationally generated artifacts, where the artifact context and its dependencies may be embedded in the conversation history. Toward practical use, we also explore cost-effective test-time compute for this new setting. Specifically, we introduce a new benchmark for this setting, and evaluate nine revision methods, including sequential reflection and parallel sampling variants, using gpt-oss-20b/120b, gpt-5.4-mini, and qwen3.5-9b/27b/122b on the benchmark. The results show that baselines achieve accuracies of 68.3--93%, and the most cost-effective method is selecting from three parallel samples using either LLM-based or medoid selection, which improves accuracy by 2.2--9.7%. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-revision-propagation.
articles.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. The code is available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-revision-propagation
articles.titleCn: 还有哪些需要改进的地方？探索在通过对话生成的工件中进行修订传播的成本效益测试时计算。
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常通过对话中生成和修订的迭代循环帮助用户生成工件。这里的挑战在于，当用户在修订时仅指定局部更改时，LLMs 必须识别相关依赖关系并将修订传播到工件的所有受影响部分。本文研究了 LLMs 在对话生成工件上的这种能力，其中工件上下文及其依赖关系可能嵌入在对话历史中。为了实际应用，我们还探索了这种新场景下的成本效益测试时计算。具体而言，我们引入了一个新的基准，并使用 gpt-oss-20b/120b、gpt-5.4-mini 和 qwen3.5-9b/27b/122b 在该基准上评估了九种修订方法，包括顺序反思和并行采样变体。结果表明，基线方法的准确率达到了 68.3--93%，而最具成本效益的方法是从三个并行样本中选择，使用基于 LLM 或中位数选择，准确率提高了 2.2--9.7%。我们的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-revision-propagation 获取。

articles.title: SGD-KV: Summarization Guided KV Cache Compression
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) face severe memory bottlenecks in long-context inference due to the linearly growing size of key-value (KV) caches. Existing KV cache compression techniques typically rely on simple heuristics, overlooking the distinct functional roles of different attention heads. We present SGD-KV (Summarization-Guided KV Cache Compression), a head-aware framework that leverages a novel chunk-summarization diagnostic task to systematically identify and prioritize attention heads specialized in hierarchical information aggregation. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B-1M and Qwen3-32B across diverse long-context benchmarks demonstrate that SGD-KV achieves state-of-the-art performance with contexts up to 1M tokens, while reducing KV cache memory usage by up to 75%. Our findings show that strategically allocating the KV cache budget based on the summarization score distribution of attention heads yields a superior efficiency-accuracy trade-off for long-context inference.
articles.comment: Accepted in NeurIPS2026 Efficient Reasoning Workshop
articles.titleCn: SGD-KV：摘要引导的KV缓存压缩
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在长上下文推理中因键值（KV）缓存线性增长而面临严重的内存瓶颈。现有的KV缓存压缩技术通常依赖简单的启发式方法，忽略了不同注意力头的不同功能角色。我们提出了SGD-KV（摘要引导的KV缓存压缩），这是一个注意力头感知的框架，利用一种新颖的块摘要诊断任务来系统地识别和优先处理专门用于层级信息聚合的注意力头。在Qwen2.5-7B-1M和Qwen3-32B上的多样化长上下文基准测试中，实验表明SGD-KV在高达1M个token的上下文中实现了最先进的性能，同时将KV缓存内存使用量降低了高达75%。我们的研究结果表明，根据注意力头的摘要分数分布策略性地分配KV缓存预算，为长上下文推理提供了更优的效率-精度权衡。
